_readme: Replace these example questions with ones written against YOUR corpus. doc_id = file name without extension and without the __vN suffix. section = a substring of the heading path where the answer lives (leave empty if unsure). Temporal questions must give a version on every source.

questions.question: What is the notice period for ending the rental agreement?
Which embedding model did I shortlist in my RAG research notes?
questions.expected_answer: bge-base-en, with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 as the fast fallback.

questions.question: Summarize the main argument of the market research report.
questions.expected_answer: Demand is moving online, incumbents are slow to adapt, and distribution partnerships are the main competitive advantage.

questions.question: What are the recurring themes across my meeting notes?
questions.expected_answer: Hiring delays, vendor turnaround times and the marketing budget.

questions.question: What changed in the rental agreement between the first and second versions?
questions.expected_answer: Rent rose 8% and the notice period went from one month to two months.

questions.question: What was the Q3 marketing budget according to the plan as of June?
